Blind Kurt Jensen gets an eye transplant from a dead man and can see again. But strange visions start to haunt him. Jensen feels compelled to visit a Spanish castle and encounters the rightful owner of his eyes.

Professor Stanley Harden and two friends discover the fabled Minotaur's labyrinth in Crete. Driven by greed to steal precious jewels, Harden leaves the others behind and runs. But he is thrown back in time and has to face the Minotaur.

The Doom of Living Ice (6 pages)

A group of arctic explorers discovers a temple with frozen inhabitants. When they light a fire, the ice melts and the people come alive again. After a wild chase, the explorers freeze to death in the unholy temple of ice.
